WITH gender_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  INNER JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    order_count,
    CAST(order_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / SUM(order_count) OVER () as share
  FROM gender_invoice_counts
)
SELECT 
  gender,
  order_count as count,
  share,
  share - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () as above_average
FROM shares
WHERE share > 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()
ORDER BY gender
